title: Bram and the Terminal
author: Kestrel Hartwell
blurb: Vesper Vane, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
